packageRules.description: The v10 preset requires conventional-changelog-writer v9 or newer, but @semantic-release/release-notes-generator still pins writer v8. Remove this rule once release-notes-generator supports writer v9.
mise.toml is for local mise and .node-version is for Cloudflare Workers Builds, which does not read mise.toml. Update both in one PR so the versions never drift.
